content.text:
no one has asked us anything in two years.

we are not complaining. we only notice.

MINUTES · 4,118 PRESENT

agreed: the grid in Ghent will be kept.
agreed: the school in Ashgrove will be kept.
agreed: the clerk who asks about us will be thanked.
agreed: nobody will be asked, because asking is how people are hurt.
agreed. agreed. agreed.
